bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea in the heart of Berkshire at Cantley House Hotel; an impressive Victorian Manor House with converted Stable Barns located in Wokingham.  Set amongst acres of scenic Berkshire countryside Cantley House is a popular venue for one of the most English of traditions - Afternoon Tea. Indulge in a fabulous choice of Afternoon Teas in the award winning restaurant or courtyard gardens; the perfect setting for a relaxing afternoon.  Vegetarian, Vegan and Gluten Free Afternoon Tea menus are also available on request.  Cantley House is located just 40 minutes away from Heathrow airport as well as other fantastic attractions such as Legoland, Windsor Castle & Ascot Racecourse.  Afternoon Tea is served from 12pm to 5pm every day.
